onboarding.preferencesSubtitle: Select your favorite food types to personalize your experience

food.tacosDescription: Imagine the irresistible aroma of freshly grilled meat, the sizzling on the griddle, and the warmth of a soft tortilla embracing every ingredient. Our tacos are not just food: they are a direct journey into tradition, prepared with authentic recipes and that special touch only achieved with passion.
food.pizzaDescription: A perfect blend of crispy crust, rich tomato sauce, and melted cheese. Our pizzas are crafted with the finest ingredients and baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven.
food.carneDescription: Premium cut of beef, grilled to your liking. Served with chimichurri sauce and your choice of sides.
food.flanDescription: Classic caramel custard with a silky smooth texture. A timeless dessert that melts in your mouth.
food.cakeDescription: Moist and fluffy layers of sponge cake with rich frosting. Perfect for any celebration.
food.polloAsadoDescription: Juicy roasted chicken with crispy skin, marinated in herbs and spices. Served with golden potatoes.
food.pupusasDescription: Traditional Salvadoran stuffed tortillas filled with cheese, beans, or pork. Served with curtido and salsa.
food.quesadillaDescription: Crispy tortilla filled with melted cheese and your choice of fillings. Served with guacamole and sour cream.
food.sandwicheDescription: Freshly baked bread filled with premium meats, cheese, and crisp vegetables. Served with fries.
food.nachosDescription: Crispy tortilla chips loaded with melted cheese, jalapeños, beans, guacamole, and sour cream.
food.nuggetsDescription: Crispy golden chicken nuggets made with 100% white meat. Served with honey mustard and BBQ sauce.
food.wrapsDescription: Soft tortilla wrapped around fresh ingredients, grilled chicken, and creamy sauce.
food.tipicoDescription: Authentic Salvadoran breakfast with beans, eggs, plantains, cheese, and tortillas.
food.americanoDescription: Classic American breakfast with eggs, bacon, toast, hash browns, and pancakes.
food.tostadasDescription: Crispy fried tortillas topped with beans, cheese, lettuce, and your choice of protein.
food.arrosDescription: Crispy golden onion rings served with ranch dipping sauce.
food.espaguetiDescription: Al dente pasta with rich tomato sauce and meatballs. Topped with parmesan cheese.
food.saladDescription: Fresh mixed greens with seasonal vegetables, nuts, and your choice of dressing.
food.budinDescription: Warm bread pudding with raisins and cinnamon. Served with vanilla sauce.
food.pieDescription: Flaky crust filled with seasonal fruit. Served warm with vanilla ice cream.
food.galletasDescription: Freshly baked chocolate chip cookies. Crispy on the outside, soft on the inside.
food.postreDescription: Sweet treats to end your meal perfectly.
food.drinksDescription: Refreshing beverages including sodas, juices, and water.
food.breakfastDescription: Start your day right with our delicious breakfast options.
food.lunchDescription: Hearty midday meals to keep you energized.
food.dinnerDescription: Satisfying evening meals for the perfect end to your day.
